verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service platform, so documented program-level limits, approval stages, and a path to raising them are a fair question to ask. None of the evidence covers this: it describes accounts, payments, cards, lending, dashboard data access, and compliance certifications, but never transaction or volume limits, limit tiers, bank approval stages, or how limits are increased. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and markdown docs returned 404, so no deeper documentation was available to check.
